run_generate_text: run the script to generate a text response from gpt-oss using a chat prompt
create_model_load: create a gpt-oss causal language model from pretrained weights with auto device mapping
build_chat_prompt: build a chat prompt from messages using the tokenizer apply_chat_template method
test_generation_config: test generation with a configured max_new_tokens setting on the model
summarize_model_response: summarize the model response by decoding generated tokens and extracting the assistant output
